text.zh: 当前项目维护的第一方 Skill 使用中文编写说明、SKILL.md 主体、模板和维护文档，确有需要时再提供其他语言。协议字段、命令、文件名和代码标识符保留工具要求的形式。第三方上游 Skill 保持原文；维护本地派生版前明确取得相应授权。
text.en: Write the instructions, the SKILL.md body, templates and maintenance docs of the first-party Skills maintained by the current project in Chinese, and provide other languages only when truly needed. Keep protocol fields, commands, file names and code identifiers in the form the tools require. Keep third-party upstream Skills in their original language; obtain the relevant authorization before maintaining a local derivative.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 编写或维护当前项目的第一方 Skill、模板与维护文档时
trigger.en: When writing or maintaining the current project's first-party Skills, templates and maintenance docs

purpose.zh: 让第一方维护内容统一使用中文，同时保护协议字段与第三方原文
purpose.en: Keep first-party maintenance content consistently in Chinese while protecting protocol fields and third-party originals

exclude.zh: 协议字段、命令、文件名和代码标识符；第三方上游 Skill（未经授权不得维护本地派生版）
exclude.en: Protocol fields, commands, file names and code identifiers; third-party upstream Skills (no local derivative without authorization)
